about: The fold (F2, HR-SYN-1): each entry of the folded tables and the before entry it equals (digest for digest), and each before entry no folded entry carries, with the reason. Keys not in "renamed" compare with the same key; a key in "changed" is a deliberate contract change and must differ. Before entries: test/fixtures/guard-snapshot-before-x1.json and guard-snapshot-before-fold.json. Since WX.1 (the cross-lane seam unit of M6, M8, M9 and M11): an entry no before snapshot holds is listed in "added" with the reason (this replaces the rule that every entry has a before entry), and "vocabularyAdded" lists the gateway keys and method names the WX.1 entries add; the vocabulary is the before sets plus those (re-pinned once by WX.1, re-measured by the group fold WX.F).
